title: CDS Possession / Under the Influence
grade_or_penalty: a(1) Schedule I-IV: third degree. a(2) Schedule V: fourth degree. a(3) over 6 oz marijuana or over 17 g hashish: fourth degree. a(4) 6 oz or less / 17 g or less: no penalty. a(5) psilocybin 1 oz or less: disorderly persons. (b) and (c): disorderly persons.
key_points: Knowingly or purposely obtaining or possessing (actual or constructive) CDS or an analog without a valid prescription.
Marijuana/hashish odor (fresh or burnt) is NOT reasonable articulable suspicion to search for an a(3)(b) violation.
Use or being under the influence of CDS (not marijuana/hashish) is a DP offense; the specific drug need not be identified if symptoms prove influence.
Failing to voluntarily turn CDS over to the nearest officer is a separate DP offense.
Offenses under a(1)-(3) in a school zone carry at least 100 hours of community service if no prison term.
officer_notes: Quarterly reporting applies to a(3)(b) violations; follow your agency's UCR process.
Cannabis possession questions: also review 2C:35-10a and current AG cannabis directives.
elements: The suspect obtained or possessed CDS or an analog (actual or constructive possession)
The suspect acted knowingly or purposely
No valid prescription or other legal authority
Identify the substance and quantity (sets the grade); remember the marijuana thresholds

subsections.label: a(1)
subsections.text: Possession of Schedule I-IV CDS or analog

subsections.label: a(3)
subsections.text: More than 6 oz of marijuana or more than 17 g of hashish

subsections.label: a(4)
subsections.text: 6 oz or less of marijuana, or 17 g or less of hashish

subsections.label: b
subsections.text: Using or being under the influence of CDS (not marijuana or hashish)

subsections.label: c
subsections.text: Failing to voluntarily deliver CDS to the nearest officer
